title: Local enumeration for 3-CNFs by pruned transversal-tree analysis

standard_prerequisites.name: Elementary CNF enumeration, binomial/entropy estimates and cited classical circuit-complexity connection
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Full original bibliography retained; all local tree, pruning and recurrence proofs are included.

core_obligations: Construct and prune transversal trees while preserving enumeration of the promised solution shell.
Bound the weighted branches and recurrence in the monotone case.
Extend the structural analysis to arbitrary 3-CNFs and establish the piecewise expected running times.
difficulty_reason: Analyzes a randomized local-enumeration algorithm through pruned transversal trees, weighted shoots and separate monotone/nonmonotone structural recurrences, obtaining improved piecewise expected running times. The promised absence of closer solutions, exact distance ranges and runtime constants are preserved; Majority lower bounds and bounded-negation applications remain uncounted consequences.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for the exclusive DOI without neighbors. One principal local-enumeration algorithm counted across all piecewise regimes. Its Majority lower-bound corollary, monotone subcase and additional bounded-negation application are not separate corpus problems.

locator_notes: Target original introduction.tex167-179. Complete transversal-tree, monotone and nonmonotone analysis retained. Algorithm promise is part of author context: no satisfying assignment lies closer than the specified Hamming shell. No parameter variant or application counted separately.
